data_description.block_map_path: Path to cache DSP block map for faster restarts. Leave blank for auto-generated path.

blocks.title: Block Type Configuration
blocks.description: Select which Tesira DSP block types to load. Unchecked types are skipped entirely — not subscribed to and not added to Home Assistant. Reduces startup time on large systems.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the DSP. Check hostname, port, and credentials.

abort.already_configured: This Tesira DSP is already configured.

init.title: Biamp Tesira Options
init.description: Configure block types and preset buttons. Changes take effect after the integration reloads automatically.

data_description.presets: Comma-separated preset names, exactly as defined in the Tesira design file. Each name becomes a button entity in Home Assistant. Example: Main Spaces Only, Whole Home
